card.name: In-line filter specs for IV infusion
card.fires_on: Words in IV administration instructions that describe the filter on an infusion set, such as the µm or micron size, 'equipped with', and 'in-line' or 'add-on'. It also fires on a few words partway through 'thrombophlebitis' and 'thrombolytic'.

modes.label: Filter pore size
modes.description: The unit or number in a filter size such as 200 µm or 0.2 micron, in infusion set instructions.
modes.example: Ensure that the administration set consists of a blood transfusion set equipped with a 200 µ<<m>> filter.
